title: Borscht Soup
description: A traditional Ukrainian soup made with beets, vegetables, and sour cream. This recipe serves 4-6 people and can be made ahead of time.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add beets, carrots, and borscht. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer until vegetables are tender, about 20-25 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, topped with a dollop of sour cream and a sprinkle of chopped fresh dill.
